recordedFrom.note: The runner prints its result object to stdout and writes nothing durable. This bundle is that object, verbatim, captured from the stdout of one disposable native-local run driven by tools/run-stardew-native-local-player-move-fixture.ps1; the capture path is gitignored and will not survive.

whatThisProves: The Mod really ran the game's own clump `performToolAction` against a live 2x2 boulder (`parentSheetIndex=752`) on the Farm at (62,17) with opaque target `debris_728803e60d6cdb56`: the receipt is `succeeded/clump_broken`, correlated to the exact request/execution pair by the runner.

The clump's own native requirement chose the tool, not the caller: the actor was deliberately holding the WRONG tool (`tool_before=axe` in slot 0), the handler selected `pickaxe` for slot 4, and `tool_restored=axe` put the axe back — confirmed independently by the fresh observation's held tool after the run.
The clump really broke: health 8 -> 0 across 8 swings, `clump_removed=true`, `drop_observed=true`, and the fresh observation at revision 49 no longer publishes the target id.
Stamina moved 270 -> 254 against `expected_stamina_cost=16`, the game's own class cost, so the swings were the engine's work and not a receipt-side claim.
whatThisDoesNotProve: One clump class only: a large boulder requiring the Pickaxe. Stump, hollow log and meteorite variants are not exercised by this run.
No axe-class clump, no `clump_tool_too_weak` refusal, no cancellation, deadline, replay or recovery coverage.
No shared-world (Farmhand) coverage; the seam is multiplayer-insensitive per the derived sensitivity register.
The fixture placed the clump. Real-farm discovery-radius behaviour around an organic clump is not covered.
